extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Checks and procedural requirements to locate or create a Wikipedia article with a given title (e.g., why a page may not exist and what to do next). Focuses on account requirements, searching existing content, redirects/capitalization, recent-creation delays, and deletion logs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original text: "You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles." Also notes alternatives (article wizard or request a new article) if you cannot create one directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request new article
rubrics_metrics.description: If you cannot create a new article directly, use the article wizard or request a new article for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original text: "Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article." Implies a pathway for users lacking permissions or experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search Wikipedia for the title (or alternative titles/spellings) to check whether an article already exists under a different name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original text: "Please search for Pete Davidson Crenshaw in Wikipedia to check for alternative titles or spellings." Encourages looking for closely related or variant-title pages before creating a new one.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages linking to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title to find related content or discover whether a redirect should be created.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original text: "Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title." This helps locate mentions or nearby coverage that may indicate the correct article location or need for redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay / try purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original text: "If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function." Advises waiting or purging the cache if a new page isn't showing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original text: "Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title." Guidance both for searching and for fixing title mismatches via redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if the page may have been deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log to find out whether and why it was removed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original text: "If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?" Points editors to the deletion log and the explanatory help page for deleted content.
